dimensions.assessment: Affects low-income working families with children who earn less than $3,000 by altering eligibility calculations for the refundable child tax credit.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to modify the earned income threshold for the refundable child tax credit.

dimensions.assessment: Substantially expands access to the refundable portion of the child tax credit for families earning under $3,000 by lowering the threshold to $1.
dimensions.evidence: Section 24(d)(1)(B)(i) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 is amended by striking '$3,000' and inserting '$1'.

dimensions.assessment: Reduces federal revenues and increases outlays by expanding tax credit refunds to individuals earning between $1 and $3,000, though exact fiscal estimates are not provided.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to modify the earned income threshold for the refundable child tax credit.
